name: Torotoro: El Vergel canyon
why: Past dinosaur footprints in the rock to the rim of a 250 m canyon, then down 800 steps to a green oasis of waterfalls.
book: National park ticket and compulsory local guide from the Torotoro office. 4-5 h by road from Cochabamba.
dangers: Steep steps down into the canyon.

points.name: Torotoro
points.note: A village of adobe houses with dinosaur tracks in the river bed.

points.name: Torotoro canyon viewpoint
points.note: A platform over the deep canyon.

points.name: El Vergel
points.note: Waterfalls and pools at the bottom of the canyon.
